records.title: GPT-4o mini
records.note: Cost-efficient small GPT-4o-family model; text and vision at launch, positioned for high-volume and latency-sensitive API workloads.

records.title: Llama 3.1 405B, 70B, and 8B
records.note: 128K multilingual open-weight family led by 405B; release also introduced a reference system, Llama Guard 3, Prompt Guard, and Llama Stack API RFC.

records.title: Mistral Large 2
records.note: 123B model with 128K context, multilingual/coding focus, API availability and downloadable weights under Mistral Research License.

records.title: SearchGPT prototype
records.note: Temporary web-search prototype with timely answers and explicit source links; precursor event to later ChatGPT search.

records.title: Qwen2-Audio
records.note: Audio-language model accepting audio/text inputs and producing text, including direct voice instruction without a separate ASR module.

records.title: Grok-2 and Grok-2 mini beta
records.note: Grok-2 family beta on X with enterprise API availability announced for later in August; benchmark claims remain vendor-attributed.

records.title: Qwen2-VL
records.note: Vision-language family for variable-resolution images, long video understanding, and device-operation research scenarios.

records.title: OpenAI o1-preview
records.note: First public OpenAI o1 reasoning-series preview in ChatGPT and API, explicitly trading more inference-time thinking for harder reasoning tasks.

records.title: OpenAI o1-mini
records.note: Lower-cost reasoning model optimized for STEM; launched alongside o1-preview with distinct latency/cost positioning.

records.title: Pixtral 12B
records.note: Apache-2.0 natively multimodal Mistral model with 12B decoder, 400M vision encoder and 128K context.

records.title: Qwen2.5 open-weight family
records.note: Broad 0.5B-72B language-model family plus coding/math variants, with structured-output, multilingual, long-context and deployment breadth.

records.title: Contextual Retrieval
records.note: RAG retrieval method combining Contextual Embeddings and Contextual BM25; engineering evidence rather than a frontier-model release.

records.title: Llama 3.2 vision and edge models
records.note: 11B/90B vision models and 1B/3B lightweight text models for edge/mobile use; Llama Stack released to the community.

records.title: OpenAI Realtime API public beta
records.note: Low-latency speech-to-speech API using streaming audio, persistent connections and function calling; public beta for paid developers.

records.title: Ministral 3B and 8B
records.note: Sub-10B models targeted at on-device/edge inference, local assistants and workflow orchestration.

records.title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet computer use public beta
records.note: Upgraded Claude 3.5 Sonnet plus experimental API computer-use capability that perceives and operates graphical interfaces.

records.title: Stable Diffusion 3.5
records.note: Open-weight image-generation family including Large and Large Turbo, followed by Medium; customizable with consumer-hardware positioning.

records.title: Quantized Llama 3.2 lightweight models
records.note: Official quantized 1B/3B Llama 3.2 variants emphasizing mobile speed, memory reduction and ExecuTorch/Llama Stack deployment.

records.title: ChatGPT search
records.note: Web search integrated into ChatGPT with linked sources; later expanded to all logged-in users on December 16.

records.title: Mistral Moderation API
records.note: Multilingual LLM-based content moderation API positioned as a system-level deployment guardrail.

records.title: Qwen2.5-Coder family expansion
records.note: Open code-model family expanded through 32B with base/instruct variants across six sizes; benchmark claims remain project-attributed.

records.title: Qwen2.5-Turbo 1M context
records.note: Hosted Qwen2.5-Turbo extended from 128K to 1M context with sparse-attention inference optimization.

records.title: Pixtral Large
records.note: 124B open-weight multimodal model built on Mistral Large 2, with 128K context and API/download availability.

records.title: Model Context Protocol
records.note: Open protocol, SDKs and reference servers for connecting AI applications to external data and tools through client/server interfaces.

records.title: QwQ-32B-Preview
records.note: Experimental open reasoning model focused on math/code analysis, explicitly documenting preview-stage limitations.

records.title: OpenAI o1 and o1 pro mode in ChatGPT Pro
records.note: Full o1 product availability and a higher-compute o1 pro mode; distinct from September o1-preview and later API snapshot.

records.title: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct
records.note: 70B multilingual text model with 128K context; official model card records December 6 release and a custom Llama community license.

records.title: Sora Turbo product rollout
records.note: Sora moved out of research preview into a dedicated product with Sora Turbo; release accompanied by a separate system card.

records.title: Gemini 2.0 Flash Experimental
records.note: Experimental Gemini 2.0 Flash introduced native tool use, multimodal outputs, Multimodal Live API and agent research prototypes including Mariner and Jules.

records.title: Veo 2 and updated Imagen 3
records.note: New video model Veo 2 and updated Imagen 3 rolled into Google Labs generation workflows; vendor quality claims remain attributed.

records.title: OpenAI o1 production API snapshot
records.note: o1-2024-12-17 rolled out to API with function calling, Structured Outputs, vision and reasoning-effort control; distinct lifecycle event from ChatGPT o1 release.

records.title: Alignment faking in large language models
records.note: Alignment research demonstrating a controlled empirical case of alignment-faking behavior; research evidence, not a product capability claim.

records.title: Deliberative alignment
records.note: Safety-training method for o-series models that teaches written safety specifications and reasoning over them; research/safety evidence.

records.title: DeepSeek-V3 API and open-weight release
records.note: deepseek-chat upgraded to DeepSeek-V3; accompanying repository/technical report describes a 671B-total, 37B-active MoE with 128K context.

held.reason: December 12 Grok-2 product rollout/search/Aurora update duplicates the August Grok-2 model story and is held for chronology only unless drafting needs a product-availability transition.
Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Experimental is visible in Google's December retrospective but no stable item-level release page/date was retained in this intake; hold rather than infer chronology.
